name: Kerala Folklore Museum
locations: Folklore Junction, Pandit Karuppan Road, Thevara, Kochi
summary: The Kerala Folklore Museum is a private ethnographic museum at Thevara in Kochi, housed in a building assembled from traditional Kerala architecture of wood, laterite and clay tiles. Its site describes a collection of more than 6,000 folk and ethnic art works, plus a theatre, antique shop, handicraft and textile shops and a cafe.
highlights: Building of wood, laterite stone and clay tiles in traditional Kerala style
Collection of more than 6,000 art works (per its site)
Folk art, face art gallery, ethnic handicrafts and handmade textiles
